title: 'get your bearings' gives straight-line distance/direction to Harrowfield and the Truce Field, but several rooms' bearings point in a direction that room has no exit for (e.g. at The Shield-Ditch, Further On bearings said the Truce Field was '1 north and 1 west' while the room's only exits were S/E; at Boundary Stone bearings said '2 west' with exits only N/S/E). Not a hard blocker — a detour always exists — but the tool reads as actionable direction and sometimes isn't.
where: The Shieldings plain, multiple rooms (The Shield-Ditch Further On, The Boundary Stone)
